name: When should I consider professional kitchen trip hazard removal?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional kitchen trip hazard removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider professional trip hazard removal when you notice persistent issues like loose or cracked tiles, buckling flooring, or uneven transitions that cannot be easily fixed. If anyone in your household has mobility challenges, or if you frequently host guests, addressing these hazards becomes even more critical to ensure a safe home environment. Don't wait for an accident to occur.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider professional removal when you see persistent hazards like loose tiles or buckling floors, especially with mobility concerns.
